frequency_question: How often do active executive nominations that reach the Senate floor successfully secure a recorded confirmation vote prior to a hard calendar deadline?
membership_rule: Members are all executive branch nominees who received committee clearance and proceeded to active consideration status. Excluded are withdrawn nominations where no floor action was ever intended due to immediate scandal or lack of support.
